 th 05/Dated: 17 February, 2023 The instant contempt case has been filed for alleged willful and deliberate non-compliance of the order dated 03.04.2019 passed in W.P.(C) No.4379 of 2017 whereby and whereudner the direction has been passed:
Having heard the learned counsel for the parties, perused the statement made by the State-respondent at Paragraph-5 of the counter 2 affidavit, the same is being recorded for ready reference:-
"5. That Before giving parawise reply to the instant application the respondent would like to submit that as per gazette notification 1175 (E) dated 29.04.2014 from the ministry of Road, Transport and Highways, Government of India, New Delhi Khata no.-49, Plot No.1429 of Mouza Raghunathpur was declared government land.

entities.text: ministry of Road, Transport and Highways, Government of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
On the basis of the representation filed by the petitioner dated 04/03/2017 the matter relating to the acquisition of the raiyat cultivatable land of the petitioner in respect of plot no.1429 within mouza Raghunathpur which was thoroughly inquired upon by Circle Officer, Baghmara and khata no.-49, plot no.1429 of mouza Raghunathpur was Birju Ram Chaurasia Age 80 Years Son Of ... vs The State Of Jharkhand on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68426887/
1 correctly found to be a raiyat land and thereafter the notification for acquisition of the aforesaid land has duly been published by the Ministry of Road, Transport and Highways, Government of India, New Delhi vide notification no.304 (E) dated 14.01.2019 and further process for payment of the compensation to the aforesaid petitioner is likely to be completed at the earliest.

In view of such stand the writ petition is disposed of, directing the competent authority to complete the exercise by deciding the claim of the petitioner in accordance with law strictly on merits within reasonable period preferably within three months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of.
A show cause has been filed wherein decision has been taken by the authority which reflects that in the meanwhile the rival claimant has also made claim over the land in question.

The competent authority by instituting a reference case being L. A.
Reference case no.69/2019-20 has passed an order on 20.03.2020 in exercise of power conferred to it under Section 64 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: However, Mr. Amrit Raj Kisku, learned A.C to G.A-V appearing for the State has submitted that there is reference of wrong provision since the land has been acquired by NHAI and as such the provision of National Highway Act, 1956 will be applicable which contains the provision under Section 3(h).

Be that as it may, the decision since has been taken by the competent authorities by considering the rival claim of party and the same has been sent before the Principal District and Sessions Judge, the competent authority, LARR, Hazaribagh, therefore,
it is just and proper to dispose of the contempt case with liberty to the petitioner to contest the case before the court where the due reference has been made.

entities.text: Principal District and Sessions Judge, the competent authority, LARR, Hazaribagh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the instant contempt case is disposed of.

(Sujit Narayan Prasad, J.) Saket/-
